Item: How to get the most endurance out of 10 g
Source: 1. Biggest prop that fits - endurance scales ~1/diameter. This is the single biggest lever and it is an airframe decision, not an electronics one.
every gram of AUW costs ~1.5% of endurance. At 33.5 g you have 6.5 g of headroom to 40 g; spend it on structure for bigger props, not on heavier electronics.
154 Wh/kg is already near the practical ceiling for small 1S pouches (the 78 Wh/kg Pro-Range 360 mAh shows how bad cheap packs are). A higher-C or HV 4.35 V cell buys ~5%, not more.
the XIAO Sense + camera board is ~4.6 g of the 33.5 g. The plain XIAO ESP32S3 is lighter and cheaper; only keep the camera if you need it.
